issue: Production Web room menu failed while reading compressed status JSON.
cause: HTTPRequest default accept_gzip=true creates a StreamPeerGZIP decoder from Content-Encoding. The shipped Web transport uses Fetch Response.body, which is already HTTP-decoded while response headers still retain Content-Encoding. Applying gzip a second time to JSON causes inflate to fail before the client completion parser.

officialSources.supports: Web response body is uncompressed regardless of Content-Encoding.
accept_gzip gates the gzip/deflate decoder construction.
Fetch body reader and response headers are passed through.
inflate fails when return is neither Z_OK nor Z_STREAM_END.

fix.scope: Web only. Native HTTPRequest gzip default retained. No manager/loader/status/API/auth changes.

verificationBoundary: Official upstream sources corroborate the mechanism; production failure/headers bind this incident. Native HTTP fixtures emulate the decoded Fetch boundary; post-export actual browser confirmation is a separate root-owned check.
